'''Tinoon''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Tinoon system/Legends|Tinoon system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] relatively close to the [[Zephry Asteroid field]]. The planet's [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] was home to a [[Tinoon Station|customs check point]] and a [[Tinoon Storage|Cargo Facility]]. It was [[Skirmish above Tinoon|raided]] by pirates after the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].<ref name="XWA" />

*''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]'' {{1st}}
